name: canonify-viewspecs
description: Author Canonify ViewSpecs — the declarative UI primitive. Compose catalog pieces (ObjectTypes + ActionTypes) into transport-agnostic views built from 10 block types (table, detail, panel, button, composite, metric, chart, file, board, queue), then declare and apply them to an org via view_specs.declare. Read SKILL.md first.

resources.title: The 10 block types
resources.description: Field-by-field reference for table, detail, panel, button, composite, metric, chart, file, board, and queue — the closed discriminated union the renderer dispatches on. Each block type with a full JSON example and an ASCII layout diagram.

resources.title: Binding and sources
resources.description: How a block binds to the catalog: ObjectTypeSource (objectType + filter + sort), AggregateSource (aggregate + groupBy + closed link paths), typed path filters with to-many rejection, column-ref grammar, and the $context.* render-context grammar.

resources.title: Master-detail record surface
resources.description: Start with a standalone detail as the default master-detail surface; use layout=flat for a deliberate spatial opt-out while links[].as still supplies related tabs, cards, and chips. Includes mobile list/record states, the Back transition, and the explicit composite escape hatch. Full JSON + ASCII layout.

resources.title: Metrics, charts and grouped tables
resources.description: Aggregate-backed views: scalar metric (KPI) tiles, bar/line charts, grouped tables, closed link-path groupBy/filter grammar, expand fan-out, labeled 1–3-factor measures, correlated lookup factors, and the PortionPlan fixture math, alongside the existing series, compare, trend, and time-bucket rules. Full JSON + ASCII layout.

resources.title: Forms and actions
resources.description: Wire ActionTypes into a view: panel (action form), button (one-tap invoke), presetParams + $context refs, submit labels, and showWhen UX conditioning. Includes the view_specs.declare authoring action. Full JSON + ASCII layout.

resources.title: Composition and apply
resources.description: Nest blocks with composite, build modal-dialog and embedded-table patterns, and use date-range, dimension, reference, and exact-date reader filters with required $context scoping. Then declare + apply the finished ViewSpec isomorphically over REST / CLI / MCP via view_specs.declare. Full JSON + ASCII layout + the cross-transport apply path.
